summary: San Francisco resident, former Seattle resident, computer science degree holder, software engineer with experience in Windows development, strong opinions on programming practices, particularly in C and C++, critical of reliance on libraries and frameworks, advocates for manual memory management, interested in low-level programming and operating systems, has worked with OpenBSD, GNUstep, and various programming languages, politically liberal, critical of corporate culture, particularly at Microsoft, has a nuanced view of technology and its societal implications, enjoys discussing software development and programming languages, has a history of engaging in technical discussions on platforms like Hacker News.
